title: Clear, practical blueprints with zero filler
comment: The event-driven saga diagrams and partition strategies alone saved our engineering team weeks of trial and error during our Kubernetes migration. Highly structured and immediately applicable.

title: Flawless Figma variables, auto-layout and token mappings
comment: The accessibility color contrast ratios and responsive variant bindings are top tier. Exported design tokens mapped directly to our Tailwind and CSS custom properties without friction.

title: Incredible component fidelity and state coverage
comment: Every single interactive component has active, focused, hover, disabled, and loading states mapped correctly. Our design sprint velocity doubled.

title: Fastest terminal setup I have ever used
comment: Clean Neovim Lua configurations, instant tmux session restoration, and sensible zsh alias bindings. Worked immediately on both my Ubuntu workstation and macOS M-series laptop.
